title: Testing out some AI trailer cutscene ideas for our game Nemorsys
author: Brilliant_Count_4480
selftext:
We’re a small 2‑person team with no real artist on the project, so we experimented with some AI‑made video cutscenes for one of our early gameplay trailers.

Nemorsys is a 2D stealth game made in Unity where every ability’s effect is influenced by the in‑game shadows.

Curious to hear what you think of the result. should we keep our AI trailer?

comments.author: roge3c
comments.body: That seems good enough to me.

replies.author: Brilliant_Count_4480
replies.body:
Thanks for the input 🙂  
We were a bit worried it might get some backlash, so we’re still pondering the idea.

replies.author: roge3c
replies.body: I understand you, but don't stop doing what you want to do, even if you have to replace it later, do the best you can.
